<section class="intro-panel" aria-labelledby="intro-heading">
<div class="intro-copy">
<p class="eyebrow">My research</p>
<h2 id="intro-heading">I use genomics to understand the origins and persistence of marine biodiversity.</h2>
<p>I am an evolutionary biologist working at the intersection of comparative genomics, phylogenomics, and marine conservation. My research uses cnidarians - corals and jellyfish - as model systems to investigate how new cell types evolve, how marine species diversify, and how interactions between animals and their microbial partners shape life in the ocean.</p>
<p class="hero-role">Postdoctoral Researcher · National Human Genome Research Institute, National Institutes of Health</p>

<section class="research-overview">
<div class="section-intro">
<p class="eyebrow">Research themes</p>
<h2>Understanding biodiversity across biological scales</h2>
<p>My work connects evolutionary processes within organisms to the ecological and evolutionary dynamics that shape marine communities.</p>
</div>
<div class="research-grid">

<article class="research-card">
<img src="./images/medusa_011.JPG" alt="Medusa in the Podocoryna life cycle" />
<div class="research-card-body">
<p class="card-kicker">Cell-type evolution</p>
<h3>How did animal cells and tissues evolve?</h3>
<p>At NHGRI, I study the hydrozoan <em>Podocoryna</em> using genome resources and single-cell RNA sequencing to investigate cell-type diversity, differentiation, and the evolution of specialized tissues such as striated muscle.</p>
<a href="./projects.html#podocoryna">Explore this research <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
</div>
</article>

<article class="research-card">
<img src="./images/Pocillopora_SanPedro_Morphs.JPG" alt="Different Pocillopora coral forms from the eastern tropical Pacific" />
<div class="research-card-body">
<p class="card-kicker">Biodiversity & conservation</p>
<h3>What processes drive speciation in marine invertebrates?</h3>
<p>I apply phylogenomics and museum genomics to resolve species boundaries in <em>Pocillopora</em> corals, connecting evolutionary history to coral distributions and conservation.</p>
<a href="./projects.html#coral-diversity">Explore this research <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
</div>
</article>

<article class="research-card">
<img src="./images/Hydroid_hermit.JPG" alt="Hermit crab with symbiotic hydroid community" />
<div class="research-card-body">
<p class="card-kicker">Host–microbe interactions</p>
<h3>How do symbioses shape animal biology?</h3>
<p>My work investigates how host-associated bacteria and other microbes impact host physiology, immune responses, and evolutionary diversification.</p>
<a href="./projects.html#host-microbes">Explore this research <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
</div>
</article>
</div>
</section>
